versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.
The helper connects through Beatra's mainland network when your computer is in mainland China, and can open the approval page on Beatra's international site when you need another sign-in method.
The helper now waits for your approval, and if you approve after it has stopped waiting, Beatra connects automatically the next time you use it, with no second approval.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.
Start with a gift-sized prompt or still, then ask for the starter top-up before the video.
Publish the reviewed Beatra AI Video Studio workflow with its English ClawHub listing.
